#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int maxWins(int a[], int b[], int index) {
    if (index == 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    return min(a[index], b[(index + 1) % 3]) + maxWins(a, b, index + 1);
}

int unavenged(int a[], int b[], int index) {
    if (index == 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    int excess = a[index] - b[index] - b[(index + 2) % 3];
    return (excess > 0 ? excess : 0) + unavenged(a, b, index + 1);
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int a[3], b[3];

    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        cin >> b[i];
    }

    int max = maxWins(a, b, 0);
    int min = unavenged(a, b, 0);
    cout << min << " " << max << endl;
    return 0;
}
